hooks.command: bash -lc 'for root in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/idle-agent-tools/idle-tasks/* "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/idle-agent-tools/idle-tasks/* "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/idle-agent-tools/*/idle-tasks/* "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; do [ -n "$root" ] || continue; script="$root/hooks/session-start.mjs"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then case "$root" in *codex*) exec node "$script" codex ;; *) exec node "$script" claude ;; esac; fi; done; exit 0'

bash -lc 'for root in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/idle-agent-tools/idle-tasks/* "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/idle-agent-tools/idle-tasks/* "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/idle-agent-tools/*/idle-tasks/* "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; do [ -n "$root" ] || continue; script="$root/hooks/inject.mjs"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then case "$root" in *codex*) exec node "$script" codex ;; *) exec node "$script" claude ;; esac; fi; done; exit 0'
